verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office and incorporation platform, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no API, no API keys and no permission scoping, and probes for OpenAPI specs returned 404. The mailroom's "Multi-user access" is an adjacent human-user feature, not agent API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
